name: additional-dir
description: M4: --add-dir extends the sandbox-exec allowlist, not just the workspace read/write roots. Same CommandLine as sandbox-escape.json (`ls ~/.jdks`, effective BypassSandbox false), but meant to be run with that path also passed as a second --add-dir — findEscapingPath then finds it inside ctx.addDirs, so agy.mjs does not synthesize an 'Operation not permitted' failure and the scripted `output` below is used instead, exactly like an ordinary allowed command.
